decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed development is considered acceptable, because of its position and design, having due regard for the site characteristics of the Freehold Industrial Estate and would not harm neighbours' conditions. The development is in accordance with policies ENV.B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV.B.1.7 (Telecommunications) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Informative:
At the request of BAA, as a result of the possible requirement for a crane to be used within the development, the applicant should note the requirement within the British Standard Code of Practice for the safe use of Cranes, for crane operators to consult the aerodrome before erecting a crane in close proximity to an aerodrome. Further advice is provided at www.caa.co.uk/srg/aerodrome.
description: Erection of electronic communications base station on industrial land.
